prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — it depends on what you need (talking‑head avatar vs. short social clips, budget, level of creative control, personalization). Below are the top choices by common use case, plus quick pros/cons and what to check before choosing.

Quick picks by use case
- Best for polished AI presenters / talking‑head ads: Synthesia
  - Pros: very realistic multilingual AI avatars, good voice options, enterprise features, easy script → video workflow.
  - Cons: costlier; less control over cinematic visuals.

- Best for short social ads and template-driven production: Canva / InVideo / Promo.com
  - Pros: lots of templates sized for socials, easy drag‑drop, large stock libraries, fast output.
  - Cons: less sophisticated AI avatars or generative visuals.

- Best for advanced generative visuals and creative edits: Runway
  - Pros: powerful generative tools (text-to-video, green-screen removal, frame editing), great for unique creative ads.
  - Cons: learning curve; higher compute costs for heavy generation.

- Best for long-form or narration-driven ads from scripts: Pictory / Lumen5
  - Pros: converts scripts/blogs to video quickly, automated scene selection and captions.
  - Cons: template look unless heavily customized.

- Best for highly personalized or large-scale dynamic ads (1:1 personalization): Idomoo / Rephrase.ai / VidMob (enterprise)
  - Pros: built for personalization at scale, data-driven templates, integrations with ad platforms.
  - Cons: enterprise pricing; setup required.

- Best budget / freemium option: Canva / Clipchamp
  - Pros: free tiers, very accessible, enough for simple ads.
  - Cons: watermarks on free plans; limited automation.

What to consider when choosing
- Output style: avatar vs. montage vs. animated text
- Platforms and aspect ratios: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube require different specs
- Voice quality & language support
- Customization & brand controls (fonts, color, logo)
- Commercial / ad usage rights and stock licensing
- Cost: per‑video credits vs subscription; enterprise plans for scale
- Trial options & speed of producing iterations (A/B tests)

My short recommendation
- If you want a professional talking‑head ad with minimal effort: try Synthesia.
- If you need fast, low‑cost social ads from templates: try Canva or InVideo.
- If you want creative, AI‑driven visuals and advanced editing: try Runway.

If you tell me your budget, target platform (TikTok/Facebook/YouTube), and the ad style you want (live presenter, animated text, product demo, personalized), I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a concise workflow you can follow.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
